messages:
paging-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: GPU queue for prod-cluster-3 is spiking. Pending pods >1200, autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes. Alert triggered at 12:34 UTC.
priya_oncall: Acked, I'm on it.
maya_prod: seeing a bunch of 503s on /v1/generate, elevated latency on batch jobs. Customers reporting timeouts.
sam_infra: joining. any autoscaler errors we can look at?
priya_oncall: pasted recent autoscaler tail: 
```
I0331 12:34:45 autoscaler.go:421] scaleup: requesting 4 nodes
E0331 12:34:46 autoscaler.go:482] attachprofile: AttachInstanceProfileFailed: arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/gpu-node-profile - AccessDenied
E0331 12:34:48 autoscaler.go:501] launchtemplate: LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch: expected lt-0032, found lt-0041
E0331 12:34:48 autoscaler.go:523] taint: NodeGroupConstraint: taint key 'gpu-only' prevented scheduling
```
lee_sre: AccessDenied to attach instance profile -> sounds like iam:PassRole got revoked in last IAM rollout. LT mismatch suggests image builder bumped LT.
sam_infra: confirmed: autoscaler-role lost iam:PassRole permission during an IAM cleanup earlier today. Also found LT version drift from automated image pipeline.
priya_oncall: pods are Pending with `0/1 nodes` and toleration errors when we inspect `kubectl describe pod`. nodeAffinity requires gpu and tolerations for `gpu-only` are missing in some DaemonSets.
cust-ops: Customer impact: partner-x batch-infer and webhook-prod real-time are affected. Flagging this P1.
maya_prod: mitigation idea: enable model-fallback to CPU models and throttle non-critical workloads to reduce GPU demand while infra recovers.
priya_oncall: doing model-fallback toggle now. @sam_infra, can you try a manual ASG scale of gpu-pool-1 while we remediate IAM?
sam_infra: attempting manual run-instances -> failing with same AccessDenied: `User: autoscaler-role is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource instance-profile/gpu-node-profile`. Opening AWS console to reapply PassRole.
lee_sre: alternative safer path: create a temporary launch template (lt-temp) with correct instance profile and matching tags, update nodegroup to point at lt-temp, then trigger scale. Less IAM blast radius.
sam_infra: created lt-temp-20260314, associated gpu-node-profile, attempted ASG update -> error: LaunchTemplate validation failed due to `tagging` key mismatch between LT and nodegroup.
priya_oncall: this is taking too long. I'll bridge to night oncall for handoff at 12:45 UTC. Current plan: 1) keep model-fallback on 2) restore PassRole for autoscaler-role 3) if IAM restore delayed, attempt LT swap with permissive tags 4) notify customers with initial impact.
paging-bot: Escalated to #sre-escalation and exec-notify (ops@redwood.com).
sam_infra: applied IAM change: re-granted iam:PassRole on instance-profile/gpu-node-profile to autoscaler-role scoped to the profile. Retrying scale operation.
priya_oncall: autoscaler now: `scale up request accepted` and ASG create-instances in progress.
maya_prod: new nodes coming up, kubelet joining. Saw `kubelet[pid]: taint set: gpu-only=true:NoSchedule` and pods starting to bind. Latency improving.
cust-ops: preliminary impact numbers: partner-x experienced ~35% 503s for ~18 minutes, webhooks ~7% degraded. Preparing customer note.
lee_sre: post-incident action items: 1) detect IAM policy rollbacks that remove PassRole for autoscaler-role 2) add validation gate for LT changes that bump version unintentionally 3) autoscaler: bubble up AttachInstanceProfile failures with clearer remediation steps 4) add LT swap runbook with step-by-step commands.
priya_oncall: handing over to @oncall-night for follow-up and postmortem. I created INC-834321 with customer impact and timeline. Handoff at 12:45 UTC, leaving model-fallback on and monitoring. :white_check_mark:
oncall-night: taking it from here. I'll coordinate with security to audit the IAM change and open a Jira for LT guardrails.
priya_oncall: final: incident status -> mitigated, monitoring. Will close when 24h stable and customer notes sent.
